messages.特殊沈潜「蝶」をばら撒き、沈潜編成の沈潜を、精神力を持つ敵にも憂鬱ダメージとして: A Pierce attacker who spreads Butterfly, a special form of Sinking that lets Sinking teams deal Gloom damage even to enemies with SP. Allies also recover SP when they attack enemies with Butterfly.
messages.蝶(特殊沈潜、最大15): 威力=生きた蝶、回数=死んだ蝶とみなす。被ダメージ時: **Butterfly (special Sinking; maximum 15)**: Potency represents The Living, and Count represents The Departed. When its bearer takes a hit, the attacker recovers SP equal to The Living ÷ 4, with a minimum of 1. If the bearer's SP is below 0 when hit, deals Gloom damage equal to The Departed × Sinking Potency ÷ 5, capped at 30 in total. At Turn End, The Departed is reset to 0; the bearer receives Sinking equal to The Living, then The Living becomes The Departed.
messages.特殊弾丸と再装填: 戦闘開始時に生きた蝶・死んだ蝶を10ずつ保有し、各コインで消: **Special ammunition and Reload**: Starts battle with 10 of The Living and 10 of The Departed. Each Coin inflicts Butterfly according to the ammunition it consumes. Running out of ammunition cancels all remaining Coins and triggers Reload. When obtaining ammunition, each round has a 70% chance to be The Departed at 0 SP or above, or The Living below 0 SP.
messages.S3「葬儀はイサンより、以上。」: マッチ勝利時に沈潜回数3増加。Ⅲコインで弾を: **S3 — Goodbye Now, a Sorrow in You**: Increases Sinking Count by 3 on Clash Win. Coin Ⅲ consumes all remaining ammunition to inflict Butterfly; Coin Ⅳ deals Gloom damage equal to all Butterfly on the target. Reloads after the attack.
messages.S2「残りし者へ厳粛な哀悼を」: 攻撃後に最大共鳴数だけ弾を得る(最大6、完全共: **S2 — Solemn Lament for the Living**: After attacking, gains ammunition equal to the highest Resonance, up to 6. Absolute Resonance doubles this amount, up to 12; at 4 or more Absolute Resonance, Reloads instead.
messages.バトルパッシブ「撃テ。撃タン。」(憂鬱×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分のスキ: **Combat passive — Fire.IShallFire. (3 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Reloads if his own skill kills a target. Gaining ammunition grants 2 Haste next turn, once per turn.
messages.沈潜編成に入れ、味方の沈潜付与と合わせて蝶を重ねる。蝶はターン終了時に生きた蝶を: Use him in a Sinking team, adding Butterfly to the Sinking inflicted by his allies. At Turn End, The Living applies Sinking and becomes The Departed, so the setup can strengthen Gloom damage from Sinking on the following turn as well. You do not need to spend it immediately; applying Butterfly in preparation for allied attacks next turn also works. S3 expends all ammunition to inflict a large amount of Butterfly, making it useful both to finish an enemy with accumulated Sinking and to prepare the next turn. Reloading costs SP, so actively seek Clash Wins and consider allies who can restore his SP. Both S3 and his defense skill, FromTheCoffinAButterflyTakesFlight, always Reload; account for that cost when managing his SP.
